card.title: The Box Of Letters
card.lyrics:
[verse]
Nine years I kept a box I never opened
Nine years of somebody else's hand
[chorus]
And I am letting it go today
I am letting it go
Nine years is long enough to hold
A thing you do not know
card.note: Written SPARSE on purpose. Sung recall measured 92% on gospel (organ, claps, space) against 0% on arena rock (walls of distorted guitar in the voice's own range), and thinning neon_saturday took it from 5% to 68%. Few instruments, room around the voice, vocal named once.

tags_sent: sparse acoustic blues, resonator guitar, foot stomp, resigned, warm, clear female lead vocal
